title: Cultivation
description: Grow a character from scratch: follow a template's path, or train them freely. What they learn — and how — is up to you.
emptyHint: Create a character and pick a training template, or start from a blank slate.

origin.label: Origin
origin.trainedHint: Grown by hand — can follow a template's fixed path.
origin.blankHint: A completely blank start; you decide what they learn, session by session.

template.label: Template
template.noneDescription: No template: you choose the topic, mode and intensity each session. Higher ceiling, lower floor — cultivation skill is the game.
template.academicDescription: Primary school through university: broad, solid fundamentals and plenty of exam evidence. Weak spot: little hands-on engineering.
template.vocationalDescription: Straight into professional training after compulsory schooling: solid engineering skills, project evidence early. Weak spot: narrower theory.
template.self_taughtDescription: An unregulated path: broad and scattered knowledge, deep in some areas and mistaken in others. High risk, high potential; sparse evidence and lower confidence.

create.dialogDescription: A character gets a lifelong identity ID at creation; their record is append-only.

detail.noProgram: No training program — this character is on the free-cultivation path.
detail.advanceHint: Advancing samples topics for the stage, produces knowledge and education evidence, and appends to the record.

freeSession.title: Free cultivation session
freeSession.description: Pick a topic, a mode and an intensity — outputs share the exact same pipeline as template training.
freeSession.intensityHint: Intensity becomes the evidence signal: higher reads as a more substantial session and carries more weight in later assessments.

timeline.title: Record timeline
timeline.empty: No record yet — advance a stage or run a free cultivation session.

profile.title: Profile
profile.readyHint: Fully grown. The record is the evidence chain: every competency below is backed by the events in the timeline.
profile.growingHint: Still cultivating. Templates only set tendencies; fortune events create individual variation.
profile.traitsHint: Template tendencies plus fortune shifts. Describes how they work — never a capability bonus.
profile.competenciesHint: Aggregated from record evidence only; there is no direct score write.
profile.professionalEmpty: No professional evidence yet — professional dimensions appear only once evidence exists.
